claims.text: Burlison identified Lukas and ODNI as the source of the implementation guidance he had called for publicly on 29 July 2026.
'I strongly recommend that, in addition to an attorney, you request that either I or another member of Congress be present with you.'

'if you are a current or former government employee or contractor interested in taking advantage of this directive, I am offering my office's assistance in contacting and getting your information to any agency.'

Burlison: 'Independent congressional oversight is a critical part of UAP disclosure, and we are uncertain whether the abrogation of NDAs will apply to testimony received by Congress before referral to the executive branch.'

b.label: ODNI Memorandum ES 2026-00818 - Preliminary Guidance for Implementation of NDA Waiver

edges.label: obtained and published
edges.note: Burlison published the memorandum on 1 August 2026 after calling publicly on 29 July for ODNI to issue implementation guidance.

b.label: Presidential directive waiving UAP-related nondisclosure agreements

edges.label: Offers his office as a disclosure channel with counsel and congressional presence
edges.note: Burlison - whose Special Advisor is Grusch - recommends that anyone using the NDA waiver request congressional presence alongside legal counsel. That recommendation is a direct read-through of what happened to the last person who used executive channels alone.

a.label: Presidential directive waiving UAP-related nondisclosure agreements

edges.label: The waiver reproduces the channel that failed Grusch
edges.note: The directive unbinds witnesses only inside the executive channel controlled by the institution they would accuse, which is the structure that ended Grusch's career after his ICIG-channel disclosure.

b.label: House Oversight Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets hearing, 9 September 2025 - 'Restoring Public Trust Through UAP Transparency and Whistleblower Protection'

edges.label: the executive channel that competes with the congressional one
edges.note: Burlison warned that it is uncertain whether the NDA abrogation applies to testimony given to Congress before referral to the executive branch - a witness routed to PURSUE may be routed away from a hearing room.
